name: _dots.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  carousel/_dots.scss — the indicators column: slide counter and the
//  dot/pill navigation (24×24 tap targets with the visible dot drawn on
//  ::after, active dot stretches to a pill).
//  Imported by carousel.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_CAROUSEL} {
  // ── Indicators (counter + dots) ────────────────────────────────────────
  &-indicators {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-xs);
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  &-counter {
    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: to-rem($space-md);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    letter-spacing: to-rem($space-pixel);
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    line-height: 1; // prevent inherited line-height from shifting vertically
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    }
  }

  &-dots {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: $carousel-dot-gap;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    max-width: 100%;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) 0;
  }

  &-dot {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    // Visible dot drawn as ::after so we can keep a 24×24 px tap target
    // while the visual indicator stays small. Lighthouse/WCAG require the
    // actual element box to be ≥ 24×24 px — pseudo-elements don't count.
    min-height: 24px;
    min-width: 24px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: transparent; // real colour is on ::after
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    // Dot→pill morph rides the damped-spring curve — the little width
    // overshoot makes the switch read organic rather than a dead ease.
    transition: min-width 0.5s $ease-spring;

    // Visible dot — centred inside the 24px tap target
    &::after {
      content: '';
      display: block;
      width: $carousel-dot-size;
      height: $carousel-dot-size;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      background: var(--grey-3);
      transition:
        width 0.5s $ease-spring,
        background 0.25s ease;
    }

    &--active {
      min-width: calc(#{$carousel-dot-pill} + 16px); // pill + extra tap zone
      &::after {
        width: $carousel-dot-pill;
        background: var(--grey);
      }
    }

    &:hover:not(&--active),
    &:focus-visible:not(&--active) {
      &::after {
        background: var(--grey);
      }
    }
  }
}
